target.statement: SynGen enhanced model achieves F1 score of 74.02 on Triplet Extraction for the 14res dataset (Table 1, 'Ours' row, 14res Triplet column).
target.dataset: 14res (SemEval-2014 Restaurants, refined by Peng et al. [14])

compute.basis: No code released; reproducing requires reimplementing the full SPAN-BART + SynGen architecture (BART encoder/decoder, GAT syntactic channel, gate mechanism, pointer decoder) and training for 200 epochs on 14res, which the paper reports takes ~1 hour on a 24GB RTX3090 GPU.

blockers: No code or model checkpoints released
Requires reimplementing a complex dual-channel BART+GAT architecture from scratch
Training 200 epochs on BART-base is impractical on CPU within a few hours
Exact data preprocessing (Peng et al. refined triplets) must be reconstructed
title: SynGen: A Syntactic Plug-and-play Module for Generative Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis
